layout.size_note: Endless right-scrolling track built from the bottom area of the Laborratory map: two tilesets looping over the whole map. Track width in world units is not stated on the wiki (unknown); the Checkpoint spans its full vertical extent.
layout.obstacles: None described. Straight train/kart tracks; the wiki gives no wall or obstacle density (unknown).
layout.theme: Abandoned King Bible underground train station beneath the Laborratory, now a clandestine go-kart racing circuit run by the lizardman King Carlo. Mario-Kart-like: tracks, racing enemies, checkpoint gates, accelerator pads.
layout.special_mechanics: CANNOT STOP MOVING: the stage world scrolls to the right at a constant pace independent of player input (to the left in Inverse mode with Visually Invert Stages on). The player is carried along with it and steers within the scroll (the wiki gives no numeric base scroll speed and no exact steering model; treat the scroll as roughly the player's normal move speed, which is 1.25x in Normal mode). Moving against the scroll only cancels it: passed-by items/chests/destructibles drift away and cannot be reached; only a character with about +300% Move Speed can actually move left against it. An Accelerator gives +35% to scroll and player movement for 5 s (clock unaffected); each Checkpoint gives +5% Move Speed (plus Growth/Luck/Greed/Curse/Magnet). The wiki says nothing about what happens at the track edges or walls (gap); assume the player is clamped to the track and simply slides along the edge while still being carried forward. Enemies are tugged slightly by the scroll, which makes them stutter. Dropped items and destructibles are carried by the scroll; Random-Event and character-spawned items (e.g. Santa Ladonna) and the secret-character coffin are NOT carried and stay where spawned. Reapers spawn periodically (one of each type) and chase the player to force forward movement. Checkpoints appear every few minutes across the whole track and move missed chests/pickups to the right. Enemies are 'racing' variants. Map events are Timed Enemy Spawns (one Cart Reaper follows the player for 60 s each at 2:00, 8:00, 9:00, 10:00, 11:00); the four Cart Reapers also appear together as bosses at 14:00. At 15:00 all enemies are cleared and The Reaper spawns; each further minute adds another. Roast Chicken with a Clock in the Middle is disabled.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 15:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards; periodic Reapers of each type also chase the player during the run (wiki)
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).
